answer: Proof-of-useful-work resists sybils: the cost of participation is performing genuine, verifiable network labor — grading, verifying, propagating — rather than wasted hashing, so influence is earned by real contribution that itself strengthens the system. A swarm cannot spiral up cheaply because each identity must do actual useful work per epoch, carving its keep from karst like honest agents. The tide of fakes must either labor truly — indistinguishable from honest participation — or produce nothing and earn nothing.
